notes.title: The Great Relic Fishing Expedition!
notes.content: [p]Ahoy, fellow mice! Indiana Mouse here, reporting live from the swampiest depths of adventure! I’ve sniffed out a lake full of ancient relic shards just waiting to be reeled in by fearless little paws.[/p][p]Grab your fishing rods and keep those tails dry — you’ll be catching all sorts of odd treasures. Piece the relics together and unlock mysterious artifacts from a forgotten time![/p][p]Oh, and don’t miss the new cosmic twist: 12 fresh vanilla maps with shimmering galaxy floors have surfaced. Space and fish — the perfect combo![/p][p]Adventure awaits in every splash![/p]

notes.title: Transformice Turns 15!
notes.content:
Can you believe it? 15 years of cheese-chasing chaos, cannonball catastrophes, and glorious shaman fails! 

To celebrate this brie-lliant milestone, we're going all out:

🧀 TRIPLE XP & TRIPLE CHEESE for one whole week! That’s right — you’ll level up so fast, even the shaman won’t see it coming.

🛍️ ALL COLLECTOR ITEMS are back in the shop for 7 days! Missed that fancy hat from 2012? Now’s your chance to make your wardrobe legendary.

🌌 NEW GALAXY GROUND has landed! It’s shiny, it’s mysterious, it might just warp your mousey mind. 

🎁 Some surprises are hiding in the game... Keep your eyes open!

Thank you for 15 amazing years — here’s to even more epic runs, silly maps, and cheese heists!

notes.title: Transformice & MakeShip bring you Lord Archain von Drekkemaus!
notes.content:
Only a few days left to get your paws on our Lord Archain von Drekkemaus plushie from MakeShip. This cutie is only available until the 1st of November 2024. You can also get an adorable in-game badge once you purchased the plushie!

Head on over to [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/lord-archain-von-drekkemaus]Makeship website[/url] to grab this limited edition merch!

notes.title: Spooktacular Halloween Event: Collect Candies for Epic Rewards!
notes.content: Get ready for a spine-chilling adventure, mice! This Halloween, collect as many candies as you can while navigating through haunted maps. Exchange your sweet loot for exclusive spooky rewards that will leave your friends trembling with envy. Don’t miss out—this event is only here for a limited time!

notes.title: Breaking Mews: Mice Magic Makes Miraculous Comeback!
notes.content:
Greetings, my whisker-twitching friends! Cesar the builder mouse here, reporting live from the ruins of our beloved Magic School. Hold onto your tails, because we've got a mammoth task ahead of us!

Our once majestic institution of rodent wizardry has seen better days. It's as if a giant cat played a game of magical Jenga with our walls! But fear not, for we mice are nothing if not resilient. We're calling on all paw-some wizards-in-training to help rebuild our school, brick by enchanted brick.

Now, I know what you're thinking: "Cesar, how can we possibly reconstruct an entire magical academy?" Well, my furry comrades, it's simple! We'll scurry across special maps, gathering building materials faster than you can say "cheese enchilada." But watch out for that pesky water – one splash and your hard-earned resources will vanish quicker than a mouse faced with a hungry owl! Remember, teamwork makes the dream work. We've got community milestones to hit, so every whisker counts in this grand reconstruction project!

So, grab your wands (and maybe a tiny hard hat), and let's show the world what happens when mice and magic join forces. Together, we'll turn this rubble into a rodent Hogwarts in no time! Who knows, maybe we'll even install some fancy magical elevators this time – my little legs could use a break from all these stairs!

notes.title: The Garden Event is Back: Grow and Trade Your Veggies!
notes.content:
Howdy, little mice! Papaille here, yer favorite farmer mouse, bringin' ya some excitin' news from the fields of Transformice! The Garden Event is back, and it's time to roll up yer sleeves and get yer paws dirty. This year, we're plantin' all sorts of fruits and veggies - from blueberries to juicy lemons. Grow 'em, harvest 'em, and trade 'em in for some mighty fine rewards!

But wait, there's somethin' new sproutin' this season! For the first time ever, them ripe, red tomatoes can be traded among ya'll. That's right, you can now share and swap tomatoes with yer fellow mice to help each other out. So, gather yer seeds, tend to yer plants, and let's make this the best harvest yet! Happy farmin', y'all!

notes.title: Elisah's Call to Arms: Battle Against AnvilGod Returns!
notes.content:
Greetings, valiant mice of Transformice! It is I, Elisah, your goddess and protector. The time has come once more to stand against the dark forces of AnvilGod. The dreaded AnvilGod has returned, and with him, his deadly lasers that seek to thwart our efforts. Your mission is of the utmost importance: gather the precious feathers scattered across the battlefield and deliver them to my sacred statue.

But beware, brave souls, for the avatar of AnvilGod will stop at nothing to hinder you. His lasers are swift and deadly, requiring agility and courage to evade. Only the most daring and dedicated mice will succeed in this perilous quest. Unite, my champions, and together we shall overcome this ancient foe. May the spirits of the shaman guide you and grant you strength in this epic event.

notes.title: Mice of Transformice, the Cooking Event is Back!
notes.content:
Dear little chefs of Transformice,

This is Moris, your illustrious and discerning chef, here to announce the grand return of our beloved Cooking Event! Once again, the culinary flames are alight, and it’s time for you to put on your aprons and join me in the kitchen. But beware, this isn’t just any ordinary cooking challenge! You must work together with your fellow mice, selecting the finest ingredients and diving into the bubbling pot with precision and flair. Only the perfect combination will create the delectable dishes worthy of Transformice’s most critical palate – mine!

Remember, the kitchen is no place for mistakes. A pinch too much of this, or a splash too little of that, and the entire recipe could be ruined! So, gather your friends, ready your ingredients, and let’s cook up a storm! Prove to me that you have what it takes to be true Transformice gourmet chefs.

Allez, let’s make some magic in the kitchen!

Yours gastronomically,
Moris, the Chef of Transformice

notes.title: Happy 14th Cheese-iversary, Transformice Tribe!
notes.content:
Calling all mice! It’s time to squeak with joy as we celebrate 14 gouda years of Transformice fun, frolics, and, of course, your favorite—cheese! And what better way to mark this milestone than with a super squeaky Double XP and Double Cheese mode? From now until May 12th, every adventure and every piece of cheese you snag in-game will count for double. Yes, you heard right! Double the fun, double the cheese!

So strap on your tiny mousey jetpacks, adjust your adorable hats, and get ready to race, because the cheese fest is on! Remember, the more you play, the more you earn, so let's make this anniversary a brie-lliant blast. Happy playing, and may your cheese piles be mountainous!

notes.title: Charlotte’s Awakening
notes.content:
Calling all mice! The Charlotte’s Awakening event is back in Transformice, and your help is crucial! After a long winter, Charlotte the groundhog has snuggled deep into her burrow, and it’s up to us to wake her from her slumber. How do we do it? By doing what mice do best – chattering away!

Starting today, join fellow players in the game and spam the chat to stir Charlotte from her hibernation. The more noise we make, the quicker Charlotte will wake up. It’s a race against time and every mouse’s chatter counts! This fun and frantic event is perfect for those who love community spirit and a bit of chaos. So, log in, start spamming, and let’s wake up Charlotte together! Be part of this exciting seasonal game-play and make this event a lively one!

notes.title: Carnival 2024
notes.content:
Hey party mice! Rianna here, straight from the carnival vibes of Brazil! Big news - Transformice is launching a carnival event like no other!

Imagine this: You're on a parade float, and it's all about speedy taps! Left, right, left, right - make that char soar to victory! First float to finish gets epic rewards! 

So, don your craziest costumes, get those fingers ready, and let's make this the most unforgettable carnival in Transformice!

Catch you on the parade route! Let's party in style!

XOXO, Rianna

notes.title: The Haunting Mystery at Drekkemaus Manor!
notes.content:
Greetings, brave mice! I am Von Drekkemaus, and I come before you in a time of dire need. A tragic occurrence has befallen our beloved Drekkemaus family. My son, the esteemed Voldemouse, has vanished without a trace. Buffy and I are heartbroken and desperately seek your assistance to uncover the mystery surrounding his disappearance.

Recently, a peculiar monster has been spotted within the confines of our manor, lurking near the grand piano. Its haunting melodies echo through the halls, leaving ghostly imprints of memories that are both enigmatic and tantalizing. Though it is unknown who or what this creature might be, it is believed to possess clues vital to our quest.

Join us in this chilling adventure, and together, let's unveil the enigma of the Drekkemaus Manor!

With utmost gratitude,
Von Drekkemaus

notes.title: Back-to-School with Mélo!
notes.content:
Hello dear students and cheese enthusiasts!

Do you remember our first lessons together? I, Mélo, was the one who taught you the fine art of cheese chasing. Ah, the memories of seeing your tiny paws eagerly race for that delightful treat! 

But now, as the leaves turn a golden hue and the scent of freshly sharpened pencils fills the air, it's time to return to our mousey classroom. And guess what? This back-to-school event is brimming with so many rewards, it feels more like Christmas than the start of a school year! 

However, remember, every reward comes with its own set of challenges. As your beloved teacher, I encourage you to embrace this learning journey. After all, just like fetching cheese, the journey is filled with fun, surprises, and a little bit of hard work.

The event kicks off tonight at 18h and will run until October 12th. So, put on your thinking caps, dive into the challenges, and let's make this school year the most memorable one yet! See you in class, my dear students. 

With all my mousey love,
Mélo

notes.title: The Divine is Coming... and it's Plushy!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the launch of the enchanting plushie, brought to life through a wonderful collaboration between Makeship and Atelier801 for Transformice. With its meticulously crafted design by Mogueta#0095, and the attention to detail put by Makeship in crafting it, the Divine Shaman plushie is quite something!

If you're eager to bring the Divine Shaman into your life, now is the perfect time. You can secure your very own by visiting the official Makeship website and, although we are thrilled to let you know that the campaign has already been fully funded, guaranteeing its production, we would love to see it come home to as many of you! Hurry though, because the campaign will only be running until July 29. Once the window closes, this limited edition plushie will be gone forever!

But wait, there's more! For those of you collecting in-game badges, you can also get an exclusive limited edition in-game badge. Just like the plushie, once the campaign ends, the badge will also be gone!

So, don't hesitate! Visit the Makeship website today and claim your Divine Shaman before it's too late. Let the mystical spirit of the shaman guide you on your extraordinary journey. ✨✨✨

https://www.makeship.com/products/shaman-plush


[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/shaman-plush][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/7682153/b742e6849493b137814b5e1087bfce4d93d31eeb.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Transformice's Summer Splash
notes.content:
Ahoy, landlubbers and cheese-chasers! Hold onto your whiskers, 'cause it's time for our summer belly-flop: The Fishing Event!

It all begins with a tale most intriguing, where Indiana Mouse, our beloved archaeologist, has successfully recovered Cancoillotte's ship, which was lost in a terrible storm.

Indiana Mouse has an uncanny knack for finding the lost and forgotten. But his latest discovery reveals a new challenge: during the shipwreck, precious relics were lost, shattered into pieces, and scattered all over. This is where we need your help, brave mice!

Cancoillotte and Indiana Mouse are calling on every mouse to aid in reassembling these relics. It won't be easy, but we trust in your determination and team spirit.

Here's the cherry on top: there are rumors that Cancoillotte found a way to harness the powerful abilities of the Shamans as a simple mouse. Could this mean that her treasures are imbued with the same powers? There's only one way to find out!

Join us this summer, put on your swimming trunks, grab your fishing rods, and dive into the sea of cheese-filled adventures with the summer's Fishing Event! 🎣

notes.title: Greenhouse event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/f6f458e90fa08e86ae8e99ecbd732232b19777d1.png[/img]

Squeak up, cheese chasers!

Guess what's sprouting back into action? The Greenhouse Event! Yes, you read it right, it's blooming back to life and it's time to flex those green paws once more!

Get ready to plant a frenzy of flowers and harvest a rainbow of seeds, all under the warm, sunny glow of our beautiful greenhouse. Make Mother Nature green with envy as you show off your botany brilliance!
And what's the fruits of your labour, you ask? We have got an exclusive badge that'll put a rosy glow on your profile, a radiant new orb that outshines all, and a fresh title that'll make you the talk of the mousehole!

And we haven’t forgotten about your love for emojis! Show off your mouse-itude with a brand new emoji that'll definitely leave the others 'green' with envy.

So, don't leaf this chance behind! We’re 'rooting' for you to have an absolute 'gouda' time. See you at the greenhouse!

Yours in cheese, The Transformice Team 🐾

notes.title: Happy birthday Transformice!
notes.content:
Attention all mice! It's time to party like it's Transformice's birthday because... IT IS! That's right, another year has passed and we're still going strong. To celebrate, we've got some exciting news to share.

First up, we've added a new tattoo slot in the shop. Now you can decorate your little mousey body with even more cool designs. And speaking of decorations, we've also added some hilarious new emojis to the shop. Trust us, your friends will be laughing so hard they'll fall out of their cheese wheel.

But wait, there's more! We've made it even easier to use your emojis by allowing you to open your list by pressing the E key. And for those of you who really want to get the party started, press Shift+E for a confetti explosion!

Last but not least, we're giving you an extra reason to play hard for the next two weeks. That's right, we're doubling the xp AND the cheese! So get ready to level up and collect that cheddar like never before.

So what are you waiting for? Let's celebrate Transformice's birthday in style with tattoos, emojis, and all the cheese you can handle. Let's get this party started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/09546f52b175e460c9f0e738608774c30c328ac4.png[/img]

notes.title: Rabbit's Tail Archipelago 2023
notes.content:
Easter is coming and Captain Neige is back for an adventure, but this time - on the side of evil?! That’s right, because Neige, one of the most feared captains of the sea, is on her last stop before finding the key to immortality - the Rabbit’s Tail Archipelago.

With the help of her former crew member, find and catch all the Easter bunnies before Neige does so, and avoid her malicious minions who will open heavy fire to turn your plans upside down!

There's even some new rewards for you to earn by doing so!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/d812c23bf75872f5fcaaa221cab0373b35608212.png[/img]

notes.title: The Orchestra
notes.content:
The newly established Transformice Orchestra is preparing for its debut. A grand concert, in honor of King Fromagnus' birthday. There is still plenty of work to be done though, and you'll have to give a helping hand or two. 

The conductor is overstressed, he needs all the help he can get to bring the orchestra to order and ready in time. Luckily you are here to save the day. The clock is ticking, his majesty's birthday is approaching, we must avoid any sort of scandal! But, as they say, the show is not over until the... plump lady sings. And you'll also help with that vital mission, to make sure that she sings! 

We count on you. Good luck and enjoy the music.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/ccbedeaafe25a558e83e39d9d7a26dd3cd44827f.png[/img]

notes.title: Halloween 2022
notes.content:
Happy Halloween mice! Your favourite Halloween maps are back as you collect cat skulls, door handles, broomsticks and lots of sweet candy in exchange for some new scary rewards!

You can also test your luck as you take a chance on Drekkemaus’ Casino slot machines by using your hard earned candy for some mystery loot! Will you be brave enough to gamble your candy for the chance to win the big jackpot?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/d0fcc032a0b9193b93b029b0740374d24a73a224.png[/img]

notes.title: Under the Sea
notes.content:
Ariel is a mermaid who is about to get married, but she can't before completing a mermaid tradition of getting a blessing necklace containing 8 pearls. Help her to open the oysters and find the pearls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/a30fe44eaf0bad09e3ef34aca13624dab67d5264.png[/img]

notes.title: Garden event is back!
notes.content:
Summer is in full swing!

Welcome to your own vegetable garden where you can grow a variety of flowers, fruits, and vegetables in the warm weather! On the garden map, you have 6 slots to plant mystery seeds that you can find randomly spawned on maps, or plant specific types of seeds by trading crops to Papaille! You can use fertiliser and watering cans to aid with the growth of crops as well as ladybugs and rakes to remove unwanted pests and weeds that will hinder growth.

There's a bunch of new rewards to earn during this event, but if you're feeling up to the challenge, aim to grow and harvest 40 peppers for your adventure calendar! The garden will be open until September 8th, so you have just under 2 months to grow as many crops as you can and show off your green thumb!

notes.title: Nobles Quest
notes.content:
The princess and the treasury are in danger under the hands of evil forces. Travel back to the ancient medieval times to gather resources, craft items and get stronger, then fight off the monsters!

Are you worthy of this mission? Then come help the kingdom regain it's glory in this new event brought to you by the Events Squad!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/2840c36d00d43f1be5bdfd7c2e78aa040d739e83.png[/img]

notes.title: Dino is back!
notes.content:
Become a brave explorer as you go on a deadly adventure through the Jurassic period: collect cogs/gears with your fellow tyranno-souris buddies to repair and power the time machine so you can get back home to the present day!

Watch out for various traps along your journey through this exotic landscape, as one wrong mis-step could result in you becoming trapped in this merciless paradise forever. However, success will grant you a range of new prehistoric rewards that you can keep and treasure as you return to the land of Transformice!

notes.title: 🧀 Hall of cheese 🧀
notes.content:
Ladies and gentlemice, let the games begin! 

🏆 You can now show off all your hard work in the new Seasonal Leaderboards! You can open them from the new button and see who are the top 10 mice in each of the base gameplay categories, as well as see your own rank.

What else is there to know?
- The Leaderboards will be updated every hour to get the most accurate stats.
- Each season will last three months.

The current season is a test season to work out the final details and will end on May 31.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/1376d04ed0a34bfe14834c04e7a18f6964167d17.png[/img]

notes.title: Happy birthday Transformice!
notes.content:
Happy birthday Transformice!

To celebrate our 12th birthday on May 1st, enjoy some double cheese and XP for the next two weeks! 🧀

notes.title: Rabbit's Skull Archipelago
notes.content: Ahoy, sailormouse! This time the adventure is located in a forgotten, mystical island called Rabbit's Skull Archipelago, and if you are brave enough you'll live to tell the tale. To get out of this island, find the Lost Eggs of Easter and don't fall into any trap!

notes.title: Shaman update & St. Patrick’s Day
notes.content:
🍀 Wherever you go, whatever you do, may the luck of the Irish be there with you! 🍀

Spring is just around the corner, and there’s no better way to celebrate the return of all the greenery than with the most green and gold event of them all! The St. Patrick’s Day event is back with more prizes than ever, are you feeling lucky enough to collect them all?

Collect the three different types of lucky trinkets on maps while you play and visit Cassidy at the Ol' Souris bar to trade in for some shamrockin’ new prizes, including a new badge, new cartouche, new hairstyle, and a new consumable!

That new hairstyle Cassidy is offering seems mighty familiar though…

In addition, the most experienced shamans can now try a new difficulty setting by deactivating the shaman skills. In doing so, the experience gained is increased by 30% and the shaman currency gains by 50%.

- Rooms with "shaman" in their name no longer activate the "aie" mode.
- Added 3 new stats in the profile for the shaman mode without skill.
- In mode without skill, the nail arrows are disabled. Depending on the feedback, they may come back.
- [lua] Added targetPlayer parameter to tfm.exec.addNPC().

notes.title: Valentine's Day lua event
notes.content:
To Cupid... or not to Cupid?

Valentine's Day is around the corner, and this Lua event... can make or break the day! Do you want to ruin Valentines for others, or spread the love? Be wise, follow your heart and achieve new titles and a badge!

notes.title: New event: Fleur's Greenhouse!
notes.content:
Hi everymice!

We are pleased to announce you that for the first time in 4 years... [b]there's a brand new event in town![/b]

This year, [b]Fleur [/b]has decided to take up gardening as a hobby, and needs your help!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dpH0uFR.png[/img]

Fleur wants to create a [b]colorful bouquet of flowers[/b] for her soulmate, but can't quite seem to figure out how to get the rainbow seeds that bloom into her soulmate's favorite flower. She's managed to get about halfway, and has left her notes for you on the chalkboard in the greenhouse.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/L5k0lez.png[/img]

In the greenhouse, every mouse will be given one seed from Fleur's collection.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vn5KFaQ.png[/img]

There will be [b]7 pots[/b] scattered throughout for you to plant your seeds, but be careful as some of the pots may be more dangerous to get to!

From her previous experiments, Fleur has discovered that orange, purple, green, and white, flowers can be created, but she hasn't been able to figure out how. She's counting on everyone to work as a team to help with her colorful problem.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QiwAm5R.png[/img]

If you notice your teammates struggling, you can also get more seeds from the sack in the bottom left of the greenhouse by pressing the down key. She wishes you the best of luck in finding the precious rainbow seed!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/H5DtQHB.png[/img]

As a reward for helping her get rainbow seeds for her bouquet, Fleur has decided to set up a temporary trading post in the event burrow. She has all kinds of new prizes for everyone to collect, including a new event exclusive shop item!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8g2U8or.png[/img]

Need help with the event, or looking to collaborating with others to figure out the flower patterns? Check out the [url=https://discord.gg/transformice]official Transformice Discord[/url] in the #events channel, or the [url=https://atelier801.com/topic?f=6&t=894075&p=1#m1]2021 Event Guidelines thread[/url]  for all the latest information on this event.

As a hint, mice that follow the [url=https://twitter.com/Transformice]official Transformice Twitter [/url] may already have a clue for some of the flower combinations!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XTPHkFi.png[/img]

[h3]Map stuff![/h3]

We also have a whole bunch of new map editor items for the new floral event. Create mystifying outdoorsy maps, or a greenhouse of your own with these incredible new elements.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3dITTrY.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XTPHkFi.png[/img]

[h3]Fashion![/h3]

As always, new items to celebrate the greenhouse event have also been added to the shop! These beautiful items are only here for a limited time so be sure to stop and smell these roses before leave the shop in two weeks!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xOv3GfB.jpg[/img]

Huge thank you to both [b]Mapcrew [/b]and the [b]Flash Team[/b] for your help, so much of this event was made possible thanks to these volunteer teams. ❤︎

Good luck little botanists!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XTPHkFi.png[/img]

notes.title: Happy birthday Transformice! - Double Cheese & XP
notes.content:
Hello everymice!

Did you know? Transformice was born on May 1st, 2010! First posted in some obscure French forums 11 years ago, now to more than a hundred million accounts, it's been such an wild ride!

We want to take this occasion to [b]thank you from the bottom of our hearts[/b] for your ongoing support, and activating 🧀[b]Double Cheese Double XP[/b]🧀 for more than a week! 🎂

We've added some anniversary related cosmetics to the shop as well, check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/2eb58517bb4f9c45b0c3769516f0d27e0c8b87d9.jpg[/img]

Here are the Patch Notes since version 1.632:

[h2]Version 1.637[/h2]

🔸 Increased cooldown on consumables
🔸 Cheese limit per day is doubled when double cheese mode is on
🔸 Adding tips in the chat! There are over 50 different tips, displaying occasionally in the chat when changing rooms
🔸 Consumables in maps with 50+ mice have been disabled
🔸 Rocks shaman skill in survivor has been disabled
🔸 Fixing a bug where throwing confetti would mess with mouse synchronization
🔸 Added old vanilla maps for a throwback in time!

We're preparing something new as well, event-wise... stay tuned! 👀

notes.title: Rain event is back!
notes.content:
Spring is here and it's time to celebrate these April showers with the Rain Event!
Choose your path wisely as you descend down the treacherous waterfall. What prize do you hope is waiting for you at the bottom?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tT5LBwF.png[/img]Belle has several new prizes for us including a new cartouche, badge, and title! You can find her in the exchange map to trade your golden tickets and berries in for amazing rewards!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CpL8ZtY.png[/img]

As always, be sure to check out the [url=https://atelier801.com/topic?f=6&t=894075&p=1#m1]2021 Event Guidelines thread [/url]for more information on how to play this event and how to obtain each reward!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2Zest4A.png[/img][h2]Fashion![/h2]

Don't forget to check out the shop for these new items! Go bananas for these amazing deals and celebrate this berry-filled event dressed your fruity-best!

These new items and outfits are here for a limited time, so don't miss your chance to buy them before they leave the shop!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8bzSMGS.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2Zest4A.png[/img][h2]Quality of Life updates[/h2]

We've fixed some bugs and implemented some changes since the last event, to make your in-game life always better!

► New icons for map categories

[img]https://i.imgur.com/60Bqd7M.png[/img]

► A brand new interface to create rooms!

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/284619339641126912/819939061481472020/unknown.png[/img]

► Removed /mort cooldown in bootcamp

► Enabled /mort in village

► The cost for resetting the points of your Shaman Skill Trees has been brought down to 10 cheese

► Added a Game Rules window in the Menu (read it!)

► When using /watch command, the mice you're not watching are now more transparent.

► All the custom Shaman items hitboxes are fixed (all big boxes have the same hitbox as the default big box for example)

► Fixed a bug where you could lose tickets if you tried to buy a chest while you already had 5 in inventory. You can't buy more.

notes.title: Valentine Event is here!
notes.content:
This years Valentine's Event has arrived to Transformice!
The time has come to search for your mystery soulmate as you run across our special event map. Find your one true love to collect hearts and other prizes.

It seems [b]Fleur [/b]has three new prizes for us, and four new consumables are can be found by giving a smooch to your Valentine's map partner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/12da4c79c7d6616315f730c3274304bec2c08d83.png[/img]

Be sure to check out the [url=https://atelier801.com/topic?f=6&t=894075&p=1#m1]2021 Event Guidelines thread[/url] on our forums or the #events channel in the official [url=https://discord.gg/transformice]Transformice Discord server[/url] for more information on how to obtain each reward.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Quality of Life updates[/h1]

We've fixed some bugs and implemented some changes since the last event, to make your in-game life always better!


[h3]❤ EN rooms will now have the same IP restrictions that E2 had in the past[/h3]

[i]To ensure that only English is spoken in EN rooms, only those from countries where English is an official language can send messages on the EN server[/i]

[h3]❤ All items + Fur colours have now been added to /dressing [/h3]

[i]You now have the ability to make even more outfits with this update! We can't wait to see what you create.[/i]

[h3]❤ Feedback messages have been added when you send players gifts[/h3]

[i]You will now receive confirmation of "your gift was sent to Player#XXXX" in the chat whenever you send a present[/i]

[h3]❤ We've added a new version of the game in the Beta branch[/h3]

[i]If you have issues with the game, such as low fps or a black background, you can try to download this alternative version by clicking Properties (right click Transformice in your game library) > Betas. No code is needed, leave the field blank and you can download the beta version![/i]

[h3]❤ In cheese thief maps, if the cheese holder disconnects/disappears, the timer is correctly down to 20 seconds[/h3]

[h3]❤ There is now a chat notification for you when someone tries to trade with you while you're already in a trade[/h3]

[h3]❤ Rooms that now start with an @ are private rooms that do not appear in the room list[/h3]

notes.title: New items + New Cheese furs!
notes.content:
Hi everymice!
Quick overview of what's been added in the 14th January (1.616) update:

First, new items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/45736b11d4b62ebeeebc1a2a09c6a6389e9fecf4.jpg[/img]

Albino Racoon, stylish 50s hair cut, new neck wings: they're in the shop only for 2 weeks, grab them while they last!

----

There also have been some questions about the new fur that was recently added: [b]it's a cheese-only fur indeed![/b]

We are starting a new line of cheese-only furs, based on the seasons. First one is Winter fur!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7682153/8df8a7b54e1d6b16c0e66e5233a022e32d16acfc.jpg[/img]

You [b]WILL [/b]need to buy them in order, like the current elemental furs: Buying the Winter fur is necessary to unlock the purchase of the Spring fur. New long-term objectives! 

The rest of the cheese furs will be added gradually with the change of seasons, plenty of time to gather that cheese!

notes.title: Double Cheese Double XP Week!
notes.content:
Hello everymice!
In order to celebrate the end of Flash on browsers with a bang, we decided to [b]activate Double Cheese & Double XP for a week[/b], only on the Steam/Standalone version!

This will help smoothen the transition for the big end of Flash on browsers next week, spread the word!

PS: contrary to previous editions, this time when you redeem Cheese Coins, they are not doubled. No need to empty all your stock, dear cheese hoarders!

notes.title: Wizards, Be Ready For This New Event!
notes.content:
[img]http://images.atelier801.com/15d89eeb6fb.png[/img]

[b]It’s time to welcome a brand new event![/b]

This year, we have prepared a super cool event for you!

Grab your magic wand and put on your wizard outfit, [u]the school of magic Hograts needs your help![/u]
It has been destroyed by the [u]malicious Anvil God[/u]… Help Prof to rebuild the school before the beginning of the school year!

From today and during the next two months, you will be able to enjoy this super cool adventure, which is a [b]COMMUNITY EVENT[/b] where you will have collaborate with other wizards towards the same goal!

[u]I'm sure you guys are super curious...[/u]

Well, let's stop the bla bla bla and let's get right to the point. Since it is an [b]EXCLUSIVE EVENT[/b], we will quickly explain you, what you should do (not everything of course! We will leave a pinch of mystery...)

As stated earlier, this event has a community twist. That's right! You will have to fulfill certain goals together, and also some individually in order to reach one goal in the end.

[b][u]What should we do?[/u][/b]

The school of magic Hograts and the bridge that gives access to it were destroyed by the Dark Lord: you little wizards have to rebuilt them!

[b][u]And how should you do it?[/u][/b]

Throughout the map you will have to collect some useful resources that are needed to rebuild them:

Wood    [img]http://images.atelier801.com/15d89f5d969.png[/img]
Stone   [img]http://images.atelier801.com/15d89f62fc8.png[/img]
Water   [img]http://images.atelier801.com/15d89f6665d.png[/img]
Plants   [img]http://images.atelier801.com/15d89f69d77.png[/img]
Iron       [img]http://images.atelier801.com/15d89f6d29b.png[/img]

[u]Our crystal ball told us that you can combine resources…[/u]

By fulfilling the missions, you will gain rewards such as medals, titles, and consumables!

[u]Be ready wizard, your quest starts now![/u]

notes.title: Can you feel the horror tonight?
notes.content:
[img]http://img.atelier801.com/0e24f1f1.jpg[/img]

Brace yourselves, the [b][u]Halloween[/u] [/b]event is back! Prepare for trouble, make it double.

This year, we decided to treat (or trick?) you with all your favourite Halloween maps, to make the [b]biggest Halloween event ever![/b]

[u][b]The “Skeleton Cat” Maps[/b][/u]

[img]http://images.atelier801.com/157b35771d3.png[/img]

If you manage to cross the 3 long maps, you get a chance to [u]kill[/u] the cat at the end by pressing [u][b]Space [/b][/u]to hit it with your wand! But the cat can [u]kill [/u]you too... Beware of the cat’s paw! It raises and swipes mice every few seconds, and you might lose a heart. Ghosts scatter around the area randomly, so watch out for that too! Kill the cat and gather its skull to exchange it in Drekkemaus’ shop!

[u][b]The Opening Doors Map[/b][/u]

[img]http://images.atelier801.com/157b3e0da75.png[/img]

You will see two arrows, pointing at where to go. You must go to one of the places where the arrows are pointing within three seconds. In one area, there will be a piece of candy waiting for you. However, in the other area, you will find a miscellaneous surprise...Will you make the right choice?

If you succeed, you’ll get a door handle to exchange to Buffy for prizes!

[u]“[u][b]Flappy Mouse” Map[/b][/u][/u]

[img]http://images.atelier801.com/157b3cbeed8.jpg[/img]

A swarm of mice witches needs to get through the pumpkin patch! Watch out for these thorny vines!
Press [u][b]Up[/b][/u] to fly on your broom and pass all the obstacles. This year, you get [u][b]unlimited[/b][/u] tries to get across the map. Get some candy, but watch out for the [u][b]Broom trophy[/b][/u], so you can exchange it to Voldemouse for rewards!

[u][b]Drekkemaus’ manor and Casino[/b][/u]

[img]http://images.atelier801.com/157b3cc0f1a.png[/img]

This year, the whole Drekkemaus family will await you in their manor! Gather some candy and exchange your precious trophies for various rewards in the family shops.
Then in the manor’s Casino, there are 3 slot machines, where you can spend all your hard-earned candy.

- The first slot machine will cost you [b][u]one [/u][/b]candy.
- The second slot machine will cost you [b][u]two[/u] [/b]candies.
- The third slot machine will cost you [b][u]three [/u][/b]candies.

Each of them will give you different prizes. So think twice before choosing a slot machine!

[b][u]PRIZES![/u][/b]

You can earn trophies, titles, more candy, consumables, cheese and maybe… [u][b]THE JACKPOT[/b][/u]

notes.title: Gardening Event!
notes.content:
The game was updated! With update 1.322, discover our new event for the summer: gardening!

[img]http://transformice.com/share/potager2016/image-potager1.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Your vegetable garden[/b][/u]

You have 6 slots and a minute to garden. You'll have to show speed and cleverness! When you're not in your garden, you can randomly loot tools in order to boost your plants.
When you click on a empty slot, a window will show you what's possible to do. Choose your desired seed, then if you have those following tools, click on the plant and choose what suits you best:
[list]
	[*][b][u]The watering[/u][/b] [u][b]can[/b][/u] to lower growth time [img]http://transformice.com/share/potager2016/arrosoir-map.png[/img][/*]
	[*][b][u]The ladybugs[/u][/b] to chase bugs away [img]http://transformice.com/share/potager2016/coccinelle-map.png[/img][/*]
	[*][b][u]The rake[/u][/b] to remove weeds [img]http://transformice.com/share/potager2016/rateau-map.png[/img][/*]
	[*][b][u]The fertilizer[/u][/b] to accelerate the plant speed growth [img]http://transformice.com/share/potager2016/engrais-map.png[/img][/*]
[/list]
[u][b]Tools are tradable![/b][/u]

[img]http://transformice.com/share/potager.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Seeds[/b][/u]

[img]http://transformice.com/share/potager2016/graines.jpg[/img]

You can buy them from Papaille, against your grown plants.
But you can also loot them randomly on the maps! We already put a certain amount of them here and there. Those wild seeds will give you a random plant to take care of.

[img]http://transformice.com/share/potager2016/graine-sauvage-map.png[/img]

[b][u]Papaille[/u][/b]

Giving more and more rare plants to Papaille will unlock high quality seeds! When you reach a rarity level, magnificent plants can be gardened (even a magical one!) 

Go back to adventure on other maps to wait for your plants to grow!

Regarding your rewards, we'll let you the element of surprise. We hope you love this event! 

[img]http://images.atelier801.com/155917567a5.gif[/img]
